translations.web: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
translations.bsb: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on his opinions.
translations.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
translations.asv: But him that is weak in faith receive ye, yet not for decision of scruples.
